sources.games: 329 league games since 7.40 (data/heroes/item_stats; 7.41 alone had too few), win 50.5%. Thin sample: the build leans on STRATZ pos5 (4097 games) and no rule is kept. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py oracle.
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 111 (abilities named in fight and skills), 7.41f.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-11-07 (support wave): the build follows the STRATZ high-rank order where it and the league games disagree; Eul's Scepter answers Phantom Strike and Charge of Darkness (Jakiro, Rubick, Skywrath Mage, Tusk); Rod of Atos against escapes (a root stops walking and blink escapes); Ghost Scepter against two physical carries stays on thin samples; the skill builds and talents are the most common ones.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute (parts and consumables dropped): arcane_boots 92% (11), blink 64% (24), glimmer_cape 28% (25), aether_lens 48% (25). STRATZ pos5 (4097 games): Blink Dagger 20 min (35%); pos4 (844 games) has no build rows. 329 games are too few for a rule.

skills.basis: 198 games since 7.41: maxed oracle_purifying_flames > oracle_fortunes_end > oracle_fates_edict 102 (win 54.9%), oracle_purifying_flames > oracle_fates_edict > oracle_fortunes_end 45 (win 55.6%), oracle_purifying_flames > oracle_fortunes_end 19 (win 21.1%); talents 10: Armor False Promise 120/193 (50.0%), Fortune's End Duration 73/193 (49.3%); 15: Fortune's End Radius 98/131 (56.1%), Purifying Flames Enemy Damage 33/131 (60.6%); 20: False Promise Cooldown 36/40 (66.7%), Purifying Flames Cooldown 4/40 (100.0%); 25: False Promise Duration 5/7 (80.0%), Fortune's End constantly Dispels 2/7 (0.0%).
